meta.title: Miia — AI co-pilot for Telegram
meta.description: Miia routes every message to the best model for the job — GPT, Gemini, Grok — reads your docs, sees your images, listens to your voice, and lives where your conversations already happen.

hero.lede: Miia routes every message to the best model for the job — GPT, Gemini, Grok — reads your docs, sees your images, listens to your voice, and lives where your conversations already happen.
hero.meta: FREE TO START · NO SIGN-UP · ~60s SETUP

why.title: One bot. <em3>Every</em3> superpower you need from AI.
why.sub: Other tools make you choose a model, an app, and a workflow. Miia just answers — using whatever's best, wherever you already are.

cards.title: The best model, automatically
cards.body: Miia picks GPT, Gemini, or Grok based on what you're actually asking — so you get the right brain for the job without thinking about it.

cards.title: Type, speak, snap, or drop
cards.body: Text, voice notes, photos, PDFs, links, YouTube — Miia handles every input modality Telegram supports, natively.

cards.title: Lives inside Telegram
cards.body: No new app, no separate login, no context switch. It's already in the place your messages live.

caps.title: Everything Miia <em3>can do</em3> for you.
caps.sub: A pocket-sized toolkit for thinking, making, and finding things out — built for the way you already chat.

items.title: Chat with <em1>top-tier</em1> models, no menu needed
items.body: Miia auto-routes between GPT, Gemini, and Grok based on task complexity — coding goes one way, creative writing another, reasoning another still.

items.title: Make and edit <em1>images</em1> right in the chat
items.body: Generate visuals at any resolution and aspect ratio, then edit them with plain language — no separate canvas, no upload-and-download dance.

items.title: Speak. <em1>Listen.</em1> Hands-free.
items.body: Send a voice note, hear a voice reply. Built for walks, dishes, and driving.

items.title: Read your <em1>PDFs</em1>, answer your questions
items.body: Upload docs and ask anything — Gemini file search does the heavy lifting.

items.title: Sees what you see. <em1>Reads</em1> what you send.
items.body: OCR, object recognition, and visual reasoning — drop an image and ask.

items.title: Drop a <em1>link</em1>. Get the gist.
items.body: Paste any URL or YouTube video — Miia reads it, watches it, and answers your questions about it. Great for long articles and even longer videos.

items.title: One bot, <em1>many</em1> minds
items.body: Organize conversations into separate threads with custom contexts — a coding partner, a recipe brain, a research analyst. Each remembers only what it needs to.

how.title: From zero to <em3>conversing</em3> in under a minute.

steps.label: STEP 01
steps.title: Open the bot
steps.body: Tap the button anywhere on this page — Telegram opens straight to Miia.

steps.label: STEP 02
steps.title: Press start
steps.body: No sign-up, no email, no password. You're already logged in.

steps.label: STEP 03
steps.title: Just message it
steps.body: Text, voice, image, doc, link. Miia figures out the rest.

cta.title: The fastest way to <em3>every</em3> AI you'd want to use.
cta.lede: Open Miia in Telegram and try it for free.

footer.tag: An AI co-pilot that lives where you already chat. Built for Telegram.
